description_en: Queries the details of a certificate without returning the certificate content or private key content
description_zh: 查询证书详情，不返回证书内容和私钥内容
name: GetCertificateDetail

Algorithm.description_en:
The certificate algorithm. Valid values:

RSA: RSA algorithm.
ECC: ECC algorithm.
SM2: SM2 encryption algorithm
Algorithm.description_zh:
证书算法。

RSA：RSA算法。
ECC：ECC算法。
SM2：国密算法

CertIdentifier.description_en:
The global certificate ID in the format of certificate ID + "-" + site region ID. This is commonly used across Alibaba Cloud services.
  --For the China site, the format is certificate ID + "-cn-hangzhou".
For the China site, the format is certificate ID + "-ap-southeast-1".
For example, if the certificate ID is 123, the CertIdentifier on the China site is "123-cn-hangzhou", and the CertIdentifier on the China site is "123-ap-southeast-1"
CertIdentifier.description_zh:
全局证书ID，格式为证书Id + "-" + 站点regionId，常用在阿里云各个云产品中。
  --国内站为证书Id + "-cn-hangzhou"
国际站为证书Id + "-ap-southeast-1"
例如证书Id = 123，则国内站CertIdentifier = “123-cn-hangzhou”，国际站CertIdentifier = "123-ap-southeast-1"

Issuer.description_en: The issuer name in the certificate chain

NotAfter.description_en: The end time of the certificate validity period
NotAfter.description_zh: 证书有效期的截止时间

NotBefore.description_en: The start time of the certificate validity period
NotBefore.description_zh: 证书有效期的开始时间

RemainDay.description_en: The remaining days of the certificate chain validity period
RemainDay.description_zh: 证书链有效期剩余时间

Subject.description_en: The common name in the certificate chain

CertificateSource.description_en:
The certificate source. Valid values:
BUY: purchased certificate.
TEST: test certificate.
UPLOAD: uploaded certificate
CertificateSource.description_zh:
证书来源。
BUY 正式证书。
TEST 测试证书。
UPLOAD 上传证书

CertificateStatus.description_en:
The certificate status. Valid values:
issued: issued.
revoked: revoked.
willExpire: about to expire.
expired: expired
CertificateStatus.description_zh:
证书的状态
issued：已签发
revoked：已吊销
willExpire：即将过期
expired：已过期

CompanyId.description_en: The company information ID associated with the certificate application. This field is empty for DV certificates
CompanyId.description_zh: 申请证书时关联的公司信息ID，DV证书为空

Csr.description_en: The certificate signing request (CSR) used to issue the certificate

Domain.description_en: All domain names contained in the certificate. Multiple domain names are separated by commas
Domain.description_zh: 证书包含的所有域名，多个域名逗号分隔

ExistPrivateKey.description_en:
Indicates whether a private key exists on the backend for the current certificate. Valid values:

true
false
ExistPrivateKey.description_zh:
当前证书，后端是否存在私钥。取值：

true
false

Issuer.description_en: The entity that issued the certificate

KeySize.description_en:
The key algorithm length.
The RSA algorithm length is typically 2048, 3072, or 4096.
The ECC and SM2 algorithm length is typically 256
KeySize.description_zh:
密钥算法长度。
RSA算法长度一般为2048、3072、4096等。
ECC和SM2算法长度一般为256

NotAfter.description_en: The end time of the certificate validity period
NotAfter.description_zh: 证书有效期的截止时间

NotBefore.description_en: The start time of the certificate validity period
NotBefore.description_zh: 证书有效期的开始时间

RequestId.description_en: The request ID. Alibaba Cloud generates a unique identifier for each API request. You can use this ID to troubleshoot issues
RequestId.description_zh: 本次调用请求的ID，是由阿里云为该请求生成的唯一标识符，可用于排查和定位问题

SubjectAlternativeNames.description_en: The list of Subject Alternative Names (SANs) of the certificate, returned in array format. This corresponds to the `Subject Alternative Name` field of the certificate
SubjectAlternativeNames.description_zh: 数组格式，返回证书的备用域名列表，对应证书的`Subject Alternative Name`字段

items.description_en: The subject alternative name of the certificate

TagKey.description_en:
The tag key of the instance. Valid values of N: 1 to 20. The tag key cannot be an empty string.

The tag key can be up to 64 characters in length and cannot start with `aliyun` or `acs:`. It cannot contain `http://` or `https://`
TagKey.description_zh:
实例的标签键。N的取值范围：1~20。一旦输入该值，则不允许为空字符串。

最多支持64个字符，不能以`aliyun`和`acs:`开头，不能包含`http://`或者`https://`

UsingProductList.description_en: The list of cloud services to which the current certificate is deployed
UsingProductList.description_zh: 当前证书正在部署的云产品列表
